name: @playform/ets-plugin-dsh-batch-edit
description: The batch edit tool: a DeepSeek Harness plugin that turns files into PROCESSES held in state. One tool (batch_edit) opens a machine, inserts files into it, and runs the transition table (replace / insert-after / insert-before / remove-line / append / prepend) across every held file in one go. Every write goes through Factory.Write and nothing else - the governors see the batch's writes exactly as they see any write - with the batch's actor wrapped in the govern marker so the governed basenames run the factory's direct path exactly once per write. The atomic gate is all-or-nothing: the batch completes or the batch does not exist. A held file touched externally HALTS its process (the stale halt, protected and resumable); a commit exceeding the in-line deadline continues as a background job with a typed jobId handle. The plugin ships DISABLED - the IDLE-forever posture. Plan: Documentation/Plans/BATCH-EDIT-TOOL-FEATURE.md + Documentation/Plans/Batch-Edit-Tool/* (SCHEMA, STATE-MACHINE, PACKAGE-AND-GOVERNANCE, ACCEPTANCE-CRITERIA).
